visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and short black hair is sitting on a wooden outdoor deck at night, speaking directly to the camera in a selfie-style shot. A large brown dog sits quietly next to him on the deck. The lighting is low but focused on the man's face. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor kitchen. The man is wearing a beige jacket and appears visibly frustrated, clutching his stomach and grimacing at the camera. (3) He displays various food items: a raw sea bass in plastic packaging, tofu, and cabbage. He begins food preparation, using a knife to slice the tofu, cabbage, and red chili peppers on a wooden cutting board. (4) Close-up shots show him squeezing fresh lemons into a bowl of chopped herbs and adding sauces with a spoon. He pours this mixture over the steamed fish, which rests on a bed of cabbage. (5) The man is shown at a dining table eating the finished fish dish with chopsticks, taking large bites and drinking from a glass of iced tea. He looks tired but satisfied. (6) Late-night exercise follows on the outdoor deck. He is seen in a grey t-shirt and striped shorts performing various activities: push-ups on a blue yoga mat, deep squats, a plank, and jumping rope. A digital timer is visible on the mat. (7) He leans against a wooden railing, breathing heavily and looking completely exhausted, before walking away. (8) The video ends with a simple 2D animation of a boy lying down and a girl standing on a yellow background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear male voice speaking in a conversational, slightly discouraged tone. The acoustic background is clean with very faint outdoor night ambiance. (2) A sharp cut leads to a high-pitched, exaggerated vocal scream or shout, followed by the sound of heavy breathing. The room tone suggests a large kitchen. (3) Frequent, rhythmic 'thwack' sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board occur, interspersed with the crinkling of plastic packaging. (4) Liquid splashing and metallic scraping sounds are heard as the man mixes ingredients in a glass bowl. His voice provides a running commentary on the cooking process. (5) Eating sounds, including wet chewing and slurping, are prominent. The man's voice becomes somewhat muffled as he speaks with his mouth full. (6) A transition features a digital 'ping' sound effect. A light, rhythmic acoustic guitar track with a simple drum beat begins as background music. (7) The sound of feet hitting a mat and rhythmic thumping of a jump rope on a hard surface is paired with audible, heavy respiratory strain and grunting. (8) An electronic beep from a timer signals the end of an exercise set. The video ends with a short, whimsical musical jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Struggle/Internal Monologue -> Action (Cooking) -> Outcome (Eating) -> Secondary Action (Exercise) -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the 13th day of a 100-day weight loss journey. The creator shares the mental and emotional strain of dieting, provides a healthy recipe for Thai-style lemon fish, and demonstrates his dedication by exercising late at night despite exhaustion. It serves as both a motivational lifestyle vlog and a cooking tutorial.
